sources.title: albef: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview albef generates Grad-CAM visualizations that show which regions of an image correlate with specific words in a paired text caption. Built by salesforce, this model implements Align before Fuse (ALBEF), a vision-language representation learning approach from NeurIPS 2021 that uses contrastive loss to align image and text representations before fusing them through cross-modal attention ...
